description: Living in survival mode is self sabotage #buildingcommunity #lifebydesign #careeradvice #IntentionalLiving #fyp
transcript: There is no prize for living in survival mode. Survival mode interferes with your routine, it interferes with your decision making skills, it interferes with the way in which your life operates. When you live in survival mode, you're living in a space where you're unable to nourish yourself. And the greatest gift that you can give yourself is nourishment from the internal world while removing validation from the external world. There is no prize for living in survival mode.
